National e-registry service launch via Anjez/Maamelati. Listed launch coverage is Damascus, Daraa, Quneitra and Latakia. Survey-plan services and other governorates are announced as future additions; later Aleppo coverage was not verified in this attempt.
Registry office resumes operation in Al-Bab, in Aleppo governorate. This is not the Aleppo city target and no vector parcel endpoint is linked.
